verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a managed data service that also hosts inference and assistant features, so a no-training data policy or opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions training on customer data or any opt-out. The security docs cover only RBAC, SSO, audit logs, CMEK, backups and Private Endpoints, which are adjacent controls and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
